Name: Now You Hear It - Immersive Sounds
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
You trek up the mountains. There, you spot Abigail, happily swaying as she plays her flute. Drawn by curiosity, you step closer to catch the tune... only to realize she isn't playing anything at all! Is she just... air-fluting? A shameless poser?

Well, not anymore!

Using [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37134]Positional Audio[/url][/i], this mod gives Abigail the tunes she really should have been playing, plus a variety of melodies and sound effects for character activities and electronics throughout the town. Because some silence just feels wrong.
